SC on Anant Singh: anant sinh ko ek aur jhatka, chhote sarkar phir jaenge jel!| Dularchand Yadav Case | Bihar News
Mokama vidhayak anant sinh ki mushkil kam hone ka nam hi nahin le rahi hain...pahle parti se bahar ka rasta dikhaya gaya...phir samarthit ummidvar na sirph hare...balki tisre nanbar par rah gae...aur ab suprim kort ne unhen sarendar karne ka aadesh de diya hai...
